lines.en: I take one step and the ground shudders.

lines.zh: 三格半高的身子，穿过矮林。
lines.en: Three and a half blocks tall, pushing through the low wood.

lines.zh: 我的爪子落地，土陷下去。
lines.en: My claws land and the earth sinks.

lines.zh: 我这身形，走一步地就闷响。
lines.en: Each step of mine thuds.
The plates on my shoulders clatter as I walk.
I walk toward the loudest thing.
Branches snap against my body.
I lower my head to see the path. Too tall.
Every step is an announcement.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，直接踩平灌木。
lines.en: I go round the stones and flatten the shrubs.

lines.zh: 三百七十五点血，站起来像坡。
lines.en: Three seventy-five health, standing like a slope.

lines.zh: 我一喘气，尘土就扬起来。
lines.en: One breath of mine kicks up dust.
This land is mine.
I look up. The clouds move fast.
The old wounds on me are all markers.

lines.zh: 我不需要坐下，站着就行。
lines.en: I don't need to sit. Standing works.

lines.zh: 我在数有多少只小的在跑。
lines.en: I count the little ones running.
They fear me. Rightly.

lines.zh: 我的影子能盖住一棵树。
lines.en: My shadow can cover a tree.

lines.zh: 三格半高的身子，只能穿过矮林。
lines.en: Three and a half blocks tall, I can only pass the low woods.

lines.zh: 我跺了跺脚，土从背上落。
lines.en: I stomp and earth falls off my back.

lines.zh: 三百多条命，都在我身上。
lines.en: Three hundred lives' worth, all in this body.
No hurry. Prey always comes.
I lift a claw and put it back.
The wind at the treetops — I can reach it.

lines.zh: 这里安静得让我不耐烦。
lines.en: This quiet is making me restless.

lines.zh: 三百七十五点生命，我一步不退。
lines.en: Three hundred seventy-five health; I don't step back.
I lower my head to take all of you in.

lines.zh: 抬起头，王的脸在树梢上面。
lines.en: Look up — the king's face is above the treetops.
I don't roar. I just walk over.
Going to run? I'll wait.
That's fine too.

lines.zh: 我把爪子按在地上，你就明白了。
lines.en: I set a claw down. You'll understand.

lines.zh: 我在这块地上称王很久了。
lines.en: I've ruled this ground a long while.
Either back off or stay.
I rarely offer a second choice.

lines.zh: 这一片地的小东西，都听我的。
lines.en: Every little thing in this land answers to me.

lines.zh: 抬起来，让我看看有多硬。
lines.en: Raise them. Let me see how hard they are.
That struck my old plates.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地上是个坑。
lines.en: Half a step back and there's a crater.
Some strength — enough for me to try.
My blood runs out still hot.

lines.zh: 十层厚皮，你只擦破一点。
lines.en: Ten layers of hide — you barely scratched it.
I sway twice and stay put.

lines.zh: 三百多条命，不是那么好拿的。
lines.en: Three hundred lives' worth isn't easily taken.
I press the wound and straighten up.
You want more. Come on then.
My knees still hold; I haven't knelt.
That much? Not one mouthful.
Set it down and step back.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，不怎么样。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff. Not much.
My tastes have gotten particular.
I'll take the food. You stay too.
You're offering food as a favour.
I'm not taking that kindness.
But I don't waste.
Leave it. I'm watching.
Would you trade this for your life?
I hold firm; you bounce off.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你就退了几步。
lines.en: I turned and you went back several steps.
I wasn't pushing, and you gave way.
My knee is taller than you.
Lift your foot — my claws are still bare.
The king is taller than a door.

lines.zh: 这一下，我只用了半分力。
lines.en: That was half my strength. Half.

lines.zh: 我的脚落下，你最好让开。
lines.en: My foot is coming down — move.
My weight. You can't hold it.
Get out of it. I'm stepping through.
I'm a king. I need no consort.

lines.zh: 你要站在我旁边，就别怕。
lines.en: To stand beside me, don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我一个人就够。
lines.en: This wood needs only me.
You've been looking up at me a while.

lines.zh: 王不需要伴，只需要地盘。
lines.en: A king needs no mate, only ground.
What I understand is fighting.
If you stay, stay there.
Don't come near my face.
This wood will remember me.
This wood will remember you too.
I scoop it up in both claws.
In my hand it's tiny.
I squeeze. Nearly crushed it.

lines.zh: 这个东西，放哪都不合适。
lines.en: There's nowhere this fits.
I toss it back to you.
What's on the ground isn't worth stooping for.
I pick it up, look, and throw it.
So light the wind takes it.
I close it in my palm.
Not worth bending for.

lines.zh: 有东西闯进我的林子了。
lines.en: Something has entered my woods.
I turn that way.
My steps stop.
This is my first look at you.
Now I've remembered you.

lines.zh: 新来的味道，我闻得出来。
lines.en: A newcomer's scent — I can tell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，鼠群在脚边拱土。
lines.en: I raise a hand slowly; the varmint swarm roots at my feet.
Run while my foot is still down.
I've no time to give you.
I don't want to wait. One stride.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，只有一件事可做。
lines.en: In this wood there's only one thing to do.
I'm walking toward you.
Don't climb the trees.
I can reach the trees.
Don't jump in the water either.

lines.zh: 那水不深，跳下去也没用。
lines.en: The water's shallow. Jumping won't save you.
You'll stand here.
You stood your ground. Good.
Pressing in, step by step.
The ground sounds with me.

lines.zh: 树挡不住我，也挡不住你跑。
lines.en: The tree won't stop me, or your escape.
A tree won't stop me.
I lift a claw and set it down slowly.
The circle gets smaller.
No hurry. I like to watch.
You ran two steps and stopped.
Stopping was wise.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，影子就压过来。
lines.en: One step and my shadow falls on you.

lines.zh: 这么近，我闻得到你的汗。
lines.en: This close I can smell your sweat.
I look down; you have to crane up.
Don't stop under that tree.
Keep backing. Deeper into the wood.
Further. Not far enough.
A dirt cliff behind you — no way out.

lines.zh: 我爪子按下去，地面陷了一块。
lines.en: My claws press down and the ground yields.
Plant your feet. Don't shift.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是害虫堆出来的王。
lines.en: This body is a king of vermin.
Don't shut your eyes. Watch my claws.
One claw down and the ground splits.
Trees break under that.
I charge with my whole shoulder.

lines.zh: 你被掀起来，落在我脚边。
lines.en: You're thrown up and land at my feet.
I lift a foot and bring it down.
My tail sweeps across. That counts too.
I hold nothing back on this one.
You blocked. Your arm should be broken.
I'll do it again, slowly.

lines.zh: 这片林子，容不下两个王。
lines.en: This wood won't hold two kings.
In this wood, you're out.
I'm not even winded.
After that blow, still standing?
Then one more.
The wood begins to shake.
My shadow appears first.
Then my shoulders, wider than the trees.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，云被挡住了。
lines.en: When I stand, the clouds get blocked.
Every bird in the area has flown.
I stamp once.
The soil turns to loose dust.
I raise my head and recognize this ground.
I've been king here before.
The king of the dirt climbs out again.
No throne needed. The ground will do.
I shake out the old plates on my body.
Three hundred lives' worth. It holds.
The little ones have all hidden.
All hidden away. All the better.
I walk to the middle of the wood.
Something's moving there.

lines.zh: 地面一沉一沉，我走近了。
lines.en: The ground dips with each step I take.
This land is changing hands.
Or perhaps not.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的肩，旧甲发黑。
lines.en: Fire scorched my shoulder. The plates blackened.
The crater I leave is deeper than you.
Water's at my chest. I can still stand.
The blast drove me back three long steps.
Something's lodged in my shoulder plate.
This force bears down on me. Heavy.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我的步子慢了。
lines.en: Too long without food. My steps slow.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我吼了一声。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back. I roared once.

lines.zh: 没有土，我的爪子抓不住。
lines.en: No earth — my claws find nothing.
